patch.description: Update Submittal Approver for the specified Submittal

parameters.name: send_emails
parameters.description: Designates whether or not emails will be sent (default false)

attachments_to_upload.description:
Submittal Approver's Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments_to_upload[]` as files.

attachment_ids.description:
Submittal Approver's Attachment IDs.
The Attachments specified here will be saved as attachments through the request.

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach to the response

comment.description: Reviewer comment to record alongside the response.

submittal_response_id.description: ID of the Submittal Response to record for this approver (the review outcome, e.g. Approved / Revise & Resubmit). Must be a response available to the approver.

sent_date.description: Date the submittal was sent to the approver. Only settable by users who can respond on behalf of the approver (admins).

returned_date.description: Date the approver returned their response. Only settable by users who can respond on behalf of the approver (admins).

forward_to.description: Params used only when forwarding for review. Designates who the new reviewer is and what their due date is

user_id.description: User ID of the new reviewer

due_date.description: Due Date of the new reviewer

associated_attachments.description:
Submital Approver's Attachments to be carried forward.
The Attachments specified here will be carried forward to the next person in the workflow.

attachment_source_id.description: ID of the resource the Attachment originally belongs to

attachment_source_type.description: Type of the resource the Attachment originally belongs to

id.description: Unique identifier of the Submittal Approver. Use as the {id} path parameter to PATCH /rest/v1.0/submittal_approvers/{id}.

name.description: Base name of the file without its path

url.description: URL to download the attached file. HTTP client should be prepared to follow redirects to successfully download the file.

returned_date.description: The date the Submittal Approver responded to the Submittal

sent_date.description: The date the Submittal was sent to the Submittal Approver

days_to_respond.description: The number of days the Submittal Approver has to respond

submittal_response_id.description: The Submittal Response ID of the Submittal Approver

400.description: Invalid Submittal Response for the specified Submittal Approver

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"submittal_approver\":{\"attachments_to_upload\":[\"string\"],\"attachment_ids\":[0],\"upload_ids\":[\"4120226e-36a8-416f-970e-880bae78164f\",\"de07e35a-4860-4f96-acd8-8360833dc495\"],\"comment\":\"string\",\"submittal_response_id\":0,\"sent_date\":\"2019-4-17\",\"returned_date\":\"2019-4-17\",\"forward_to\":{\"user_id\":161072,\"due_date\":\"2019-09-20\"},\"associated_attachments\":[{\"attachment_id\":0,\"attachment_source_id\":0,\"attachment_source_type\":\"string\"}]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/submittal_approvers/%7Bid%7D?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&send_emails=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&submittal_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
